decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions and outbuilding would constitute an overdevelopment of the site by reason of their design, position and coverage of the site which would reduce the overall provision of amenity space. The proposal would not be subordinate to and would be out of character with the appearance of the property itself and the streetscene. It is thereby contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Revised Extensions Guidelines (2002).

Condition : 2 - The proposed conservatory would lead to a significant loss of privacy to the adjoining occupiers. It is thereby contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Revised Extensions Guidelines (2002).
description: Erection of a single storey front, side and rear extension, detached single storey garden store and boundary wall to dwellinghouse
